assumption_corrections: Widget_WritePositionAfterAdmission (653510) is vslot 0xd8 in every widget vtable (CWidget 6fb77708, CSelectable 6fb778d4, CItem 6fb77aa8, CDestructable 6fb7d708, CCaptainAI 6fbe0000, CUnit 6fb77eb0); data ref 6fb77f88 is CUnit+0xd8, not +0x180.

ambiguous_sites.why: Raw push count (11) equals widget vslotdc arity; excluded only because the receiver is a factory-created agent type-checked against Drunken Haze missile class 0x4d4e6468.
Decompiler shows a 5-argument vslot180 call; disassembly shows 10 pushes (5 attributed by the decompiler to FUN_6f652270). Kept as a unit placement.

Receivers come from an item-owned identity array (+0x98/+0xa0); 0-argument vslot1ac is incompatible with CUnit/CItem constructors, but the receiver class was inferred from layout, not from a type check.

Function is referenced from CAbilityAuraPlague vslot284 but calls a helper named CAbilityChaosBase_GetReplacementUnitID; the producer is the Aap1 death spawn, the helper name is a shared authored-UnitID reader.
DisablePathing body is not a defined Ghidra function; bytes decoded manually. The consumer of Captain+6c bit4000 was not found.

Classified by module range plus caller vtables (CFrame/glue) and 0-2 argument calls; per-site push counts are in pushcount.txt. A UI receiver cannot be a widget here because widget vslotd8/dc require 11 stack arguments.
